views.definition:
WITH snap AS (
         SELECT post_snapshots.id,
            post_snapshots.post_id,
            post_snapshots."timestamp",
            post_snapshots.view_count,
            post_snapshots.like_count,
            post_snapshots.dislike_count,
            post_snapshots.comment_count
           FROM post_snapshots
          WHERE (post_snapshots."timestamp" >= (now() - '00:30:00'::interval))
        ), latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (snap.post_id) snap.post_id,
            snap.view_count,
            snap.comment_count,
            snap.like_count,
            snap.dislike_count
           FROM snap
          ORDER BY snap.post_id, snap."timestamp" DESC
        ), earliest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (snap.post_id) snap.post_id,
            snap.view_count,
            snap.comment_count,
            snap.like_count,
            snap.dislike_count
           FROM snap
          ORDER BY snap.post_id, snap."timestamp"
        )
 SELECT p.id AS post_id,
    p.title,
    (latest.view_count - earliest.view_count) AS view_delta,
    (latest.comment_count - earliest.comment_count) AS comment_delta,
    (latest.like_count - earliest.like_count) AS like_delta,
    (latest.dislike_count - earliest.dislike_count) AS dislike_delta,
    (((latest.view_count - earliest.view_count) + ((latest.comment_count - earliest.comment_count) * 3)) + ((latest.like_count - earliest.like_count) * 2)) AS hot_score,
    max(latest.view_count) AS latest_views
   FROM ((latest
     JOIN earliest USING (post_id))
     JOIN posts p ON ((p.id = latest.post_id)))
  GROUP BY p.id, p.title, (latest.view_count - earliest.view_count), (latest.comment_count - earliest.comment_count), (latest.like_count - earliest.like_count), (latest.dislike_count - earliest.dislike_count), (((latest.view_count - earliest.view_count) + ((latest.comment_count - earliest.comment_count) * 3)) + ((latest.like_count - earliest.like_count) * 2));

WITH ranges AS (
         SELECT '3h'::text AS range_label,
            '03:00:00'::interval AS iv
        UNION ALL
         SELECT '6h'::text,
            '06:00:00'::interval AS "interval"
        UNION ALL
         SELECT '24h'::text,
            '24:00:00'::interval AS "interval"
        UNION ALL
         SELECT '1w'::text,
            '7 days'::interval AS "interval"
        )
 SELECT r.range_label,
    pt.post_id,
    sum(pt.view_delta) AS view_delta,
    sum(pt.comment_delta) AS comment_delta,
    sum(pt.like_delta) AS like_delta,
    sum(pt.dislike_delta) AS dislike_delta,
    sum(pt.hot_score) AS hot_score,
    max(pt.window_end) AS window_end
   FROM (post_trends pt
     JOIN ranges r ON ((pt.window_end >= (now() - r.iv))))
  GROUP BY r.range_label, pt.post_id;
